channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Europe, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Europe, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Jane Street Graduate Research Fellowship 2027 (tuition plus USD 50,000 stipend) (closes 13 Nov)
item.description:
Jane Street
Deadline: 13 Nov 2026
Award: Full tuition and fees for the award year plus a USD 50,000 stipend (or local-currency equivalent; taxable). Finalists receive USD 5,000. No application fee.

Jane Street's Graduate Research Fellowship supports exceptional doctoral students in electrical engineering and computer science, mathematics, physics or statistics; research does not need to relate to trading.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: ARCAthens: Athens Residency Fellowships (Spring 2027) (closes 14 Nov)
item.description:
ARCAthens
Deadline: 14 Nov 2026, 23:00 EST
Award: Fully funded: housing, travel, a Fellowship Prize and a weekly stipend (most recent published terms, Fall 2026: USD 3,000 Fellowship Prize and USD 200/week stipend, round-trip airfare reimbursed). No application fee.

The Athens Residency is the flagship program of ARCAthens, a not-for-profit founded in 2017, offering fully funded Fellowships for visual artists and curators to live and work in Athens.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Democracy Foundation: Democracy Residency 'European Dream' 2027 (Kuldiga, Latvia; Liepaja European Capital of Culture) (closes 15 Nov)
item.description:
Democracy Foundation (Kuldiga), part of the Liepaja 2027 European Capital of Culture programme
Deadline: 15 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 1,000 stipend per participant (covering expenses during the residency, including travel), plus up to EUR 1,000 per participant to develop and run their activity, and accommodation in Kuldiga's Old Town. Six participants. No application fee stated.

International interdisciplinary residency run by the Democracy Foundation in Kuldiga, Latvia, as part of the Liepaja 2027 European Capital of Culture programme.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Horizons Arts-Nature en Sancy 2027: Open Call for Ephemeral In Situ Artworks (21st edition) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
Sancy Tourist Office (Office de Tourisme du Sancy)
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026, 09:00 CET
Award: EUR 8,000 (all taxes included) per selected artist or group: EUR 6,500 artistic costs and EUR 1,500 royalties (recommended proportion), travel costs included. 10 works commissioned. No application fee mentioned.

The 21st edition of Horizons Arts-Nature en Sancy, an open-air art exhibition in the Massif du Sancy (Auvergne, France) running 19 June to 26 September 2027.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Mophradat New Agents 2027: collective curatorial program (USD 6,000 stipend, Arab world) (closes 6 Dec)
item.description:
Mophradat
Deadline: 6 Dec 2026
Award: USD 6,000 stipend per participant, to use at their discretion, paid 2,500 / 2,500 / 1,000. Mophradat also covers retreat travel and a budget for the public event. Number of participants not stated (a small group). No application fee stated.

New Agents brings a small group of art practitioners (artists, curators and researchers) together for ten months to co-develop and realise a public event, such as a conference, festival or exhibition, that foregrounds the collective curatorial experience rather than the participants' individual...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie: Open Call Cultural Education and Digital Technology 2026 (closes 16 Dec)
item.description:
Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie (with LKCA and DEN)
Deadline: 16 Dec 2026, 15:00 CET
Award: EUR 10,000 to EUR 25,000 per project, up to 100% of total project costs (no co-funding required). Total budget EUR 500,000.

Open call (Open Oproep Cultuureducatie en Digitale Technologie) for cultural education projects in which children and young people work creatively with digital technology. Run by the Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie with LKCA and DEN.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: 2200: 2027 Residency for Emerging Artists (Flims, Furka Pass or Ponte Brolla, Switzerland; CHF 500 a month) (closes 31 Dec)
item.description:
2200
Deadline: 31 Dec 2026
Award: CHF 500 monthly stipend (about CHF 1,500 for a three-month stay), plus a studio and accommodation. Travel support negotiable. No application fee stated.

Residency giving emerging artists time and space away from their usual routine. Residents live and work on site in Switzerland for about three months on a project that grows out of the place.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Berlin Senate Work and Research Stipends 2027: Early Music, New Music and Sound Art (Klangkunst) (closes 12 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Senate Department for Culture and Social Cohesion, Berlin
Deadline: 12 Jan 2027, 14:00 CET
Award: EUR 12,000 work stipend or EUR 8,000 research stipend (number of awards not stated).

The Berlin Senate's annual stipends for professional musicians and sound artists living in Berlin, here in the early music, new music and sound art (Klangkunst) strand: a EUR 12,000 work stipend or a EUR 8,000 research stipend.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Stiftung Kunstfonds: KUNSTFONDS_Stipendium 2027 (EUR 18,000 for 6 months, Germany-based visual artists) (closes 15 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Stiftung Kunstfonds
Deadline: 15 Jan 2027
Award: EUR 18,000 over 6 months. No application fee.

Working grant for professional freelance visual artists, media artists included, to concentrate on their practice for six months. The call opened 1 November 2026.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Netherland-America Foundation: Cultural Grant Program (1 February 2027 Cut-Off) (closes 1 Feb 2027)
item.description:
The Netherland-America Foundation (NAF)
Deadline: 1 Feb 2027
Award: Typically up to USD 5,000 per project, depending on scope and impact; higher amounts possible depending on available budget. No application fee.

The Netherland-America Foundation funds professional artistic and cultural projects that show a clear exchange between Dutch and American artists, institutions or audiences, such as exhibitions, performances and other cultural initiatives that promote dialogue and collaboration.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: IJ4EU Freelancer Support Scheme 2026-27, Second Call (cross-border teams of freelance journalists) (closes 2 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Investigative Journalism for Europe (IJ4EU): International Press Institute and European Journalism Centre
Deadline: 2 Feb 2027
Award: Up to EUR 20,000 per team, plus training and mentoring.

A strand of IJ4EU for freelance journalists: teams of at least two freelancers in two eligible countries receive funding, training and mentoring for a cross-border investigation.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: IJ4EU Investigation Support Scheme 2026-27, Second Call (cross-border investigative journalism) (closes 2 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Investigative Journalism for Europe (IJ4EU): International Press Institute and European Journalism Centre
Deadline: 2 Feb 2027
Award: EUR 5,000 to 50,000 per project, from a EUR 1.2 million pot.

IJ4EU funds cross-border investigative journalism in the public interest, by teams of journalists and newsrooms working across at least two eligible countries. Eligibility is by country of residence, not citizenship; applications are in English.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Horizon Europe Cluster 2 2027: Open Topic on Reinvigorating and Shielding European Democracy (DEMOCRACY-09, two-stage) (closes 4 May 2027)
item.description:
European Research Executive Agency (REA) / European Commission, Horizon Europe
Deadline: 4 May 2027
Award: EUR 2.0 to 3.7 million per project; EUR 22 million indicative topic budget. Research and Innovation Action.

Two-stage open topic in the Horizon Europe Cluster 2 call 'Culture, Creativity and Inclusive Society - 2027 - Two-stage' (HORIZON-CL2-2027-02-DEMOCRACY-09-two-stage). Opens 2 March 2027; first-stage deadline 4 May 2027 (short proposal), with invited full proposals in a second stage.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Horizon Europe Cluster 2 2027: AI, Deepfakes and Democracy (DEMOCRACY-04) and The Role of Private Companies in Democracy (DEMOCRACY-07) (closes 23 Sep 2027)
item.description:
European Research Executive Agency (REA) / European Commission, Horizon Europe
Deadline: 23 Sep 2027
Award: DEMOCRACY-04: EUR 3.5 to 4.0 million per project, EUR 20 million indicative topic budget. DEMOCRACY-07: EUR 3.5 to 4.0 million per project, EUR 8 million indicative topic budget. Lump-sum Research and Innovation Actions.

Two 2027 topics in the Horizon Europe Cluster 2 call 'Culture, Creativity and Inclusive Society - 2027' (opens 13 May 2027, deadline 23 September 2027), both Research and Innovation Actions with lump-sum funding.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Follow Fluxus: After Fluxus Scholarship 2026/27 (EUR 10,000, 3-month studio and exhibition, Wiesbaden)
item.description: Nassauischer Kunstverein Wiesbaden, with the City of Wiesbaden · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · EUR 10,000 grant plus a rent-free 70.88 sqm live/work studio at the Kunsthaus Wiesbaden for three months and a follow-up exhibition at the Nassauischer Kunstverein. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: HIAP x Sumud: Residency for Palestinian Artists in Helsinki, Spring 2027 (EUR 3,600 working grant)
item.description: HIAP Helsinki International Artist Programme, with Sumud - The Finnish Palestine Network · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · EUR 3,600 working grant, a free 63 sqm live/work studio, one return trip, and a visa budget covering application fees and visa-office travel. No application fee.

item.title: ART4MENTAL open call for artists: VR content for mental-health support (EUR 5,000 sub-grants)
item.description: ART4MENTAL (Creative Europe project) · deadline 11 Nov 2026 · Sub-grant of up to EUR 5,000 per artist for 20 selected artists (EUR 100,000 pool), plus VR training, mentorship, a residency in the Ukrainian Carpathians and exhibition opportunities. No application fee.

item.title: Arts Council of Ireland: Festivals Investment Scheme 2027, Round 2
item.description: Arts Council of Ireland / An Chomhairle Ealaion · deadline 19 Nov 2026 · Up to EUR 45,000 per festival. Round 1 used three bands: Band A up to EUR 10,000, Band B EUR 10,001 to 25,000, Band C EUR 25,001 to 45,000. No application fee.

item.title: Netherlands Embassy in Brussels: Open Call for Cultural Project Support
item.description: Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Brussels · deadline 03 Nov 2026 · Up to EUR 5,000 per project.

item.title: IKSV Ortaklasa: EU-Turkiye Cultural Partnership Call for Proposals 2026
item.description: Istanbul Foundation for Culture and Arts (IKSV) with Culture Action Europe, funded by the European Commission · deadline 18 Dec 2026 · EUR 60,000 to 120,000 per project (total budget EUR 890,000); grants cover 70 to 95 percent of eligible costs, with a minimum 5 percent cash co-financing. Project duration 9 to 12 months.

item.title: Kulturstiftung des Bundes: General Project Funding, January 2027 round (Allgemeine Projektfoerderung)
item.description: Kulturstiftung des Bundes (German Federal Cultural Foundation) · deadline 31 Jan 2027 · No fixed ceiling, but total project costs must exceed EUR 50,000 to be eligible. The Foundation allocates up to EUR 10 million per year across this line. At least 20 percent of total project costs must be secured from own capital and/or third-party funding. No application fee.

item.title: Kooperativa x Flanders Arts Institute: South-Eastern Europe Mobility Programme 2026-27
item.description: Flanders Arts Institute (Kunstenpunt) and Kooperativa · deadline 01 Mar 2027 · Fully funded mobility: travel costs, accommodation and per diems calculated per Erasmus+ formulas, plus up to EUR 300 for the host organisation's costs. Fifteen grants available. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Moves Europe: Call for Individual Mobility 2026-2027
item.description: Creative Europe (Culture Moves Europe), implemented by the Goethe-Institut · deadline 30 Apr 2027 · EUR 85 per day of project implementation, plus travel allowance of EUR 400 (under 5,000 km) or EUR 800 (from 5,000 km). Top-ups where applicable: green mobility EUR 400, overseas countries and territories / outermost regions EUR 175, family EUR 200 per child under 18, visa EUR 120. Accessibility support: EUR 30 per day plus actual cost or fixed allowance for personal assistance or sign language interpretation. No application fee.

item.title: OASis Bom Dia Residency 2027 at Cultivamos Cultura (Sao Luis, Portugal)
item.description: Cultivamos Cultura (European OASis project) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,300 project fee, travel budget up to EUR 500, production and material expenses up to EUR 1,600 (pre-approved), food per diem, plus free accommodation in a private room in a shared farmhouse and access to a workspace or studio and all Cultivamos Cultura spaces and resources.

item.title: make-a-thek: Mobility Scheme & Knowledge Exchange Programme (Europe + pilot countries)
item.description: make-a-thek (coordinated by Fab Lab Barcelona at IAAC, funded by Horizon Europe) · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · Mobility Scheme: EUR 1,000 flat stipend for experienced practitioners. Knowledge Exchange Programme: EUR 850 flat stipend. Up to 12 participants per track annually. No application fee.

item.title: EU CERV: European Remembrance 2026-27 (CERV-2026-CITIZENS-REM)
item.description: European Commission / EACEA (Citizens, Equality, Rights and Values Programme) · deadline 24 Feb 2027 · EUR 50,000 to EUR 500,000 per project, from an estimated call budget of EUR 28 million (EUR 14M Holocaust remembrance of Jewish victims; EUR 5M genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity incl. Roma and LGBTIQ+ victims; EUR 5M colonialism, slavery and migration; EUR 4M democratic transitions). No application fee.

item.title: La Scam: Bourses Brouillon d'un reve Sonore (Radio and Podcast Authors, rolling)
item.description: La Scam (Societe civile des auteurs multimedia) · deadline Rolling / undated · EUR 2,500 to EUR 6,000 per bourse, paid directly to the author 4 to 5 weeks after contract signing; over EUR 830,000 is distributed annually across all Brouillon d'un reve categories. No application fee.
